objections.claim: The steady-state ruleset contradicts the claimed sole-merger boundary: §5(b2) and §5(e) retain the Eye in the protected-main actor-restriction bypass set, so the Eye can merge a PR without the controller's producer-authenticated checks, signed pre-merge acceptance validation, configuration attestation, or post-merge attestation. This is not merely the recorded compromised-Eye residual because no credential compromise or ruleset change is required; the configured ordinary path itself bypasses the deterministic controller. §6 also incorrectly calls E1 the only pre-controller merge even though Phase A is explicitly merged first. The approach must enumerate both bootstrap merges and remove the Eye's steady-state main-update bypass after E1.
